premise.claim: CacheEngine.getRuntimeInfo() builds its RuntimeInfo with an empty tiered store instead of the one declared in the spec, so fluid.io/s-h-cache-t-<ns>-<name> is written as 0B and the fluid.io/s-h-cache-{m,d}- labels never appear on nodes running worker pods (issue #6174).
premise.evidence: On merge-base f2785f84 the harness goes red exactly as the issue describes: GetLevelStorageMap returns map[] and the node gets fluid.io/s-h-cache-t-default-demo="0B" with no -m-/-d- labels. See results/base-run.txt. On the PR head the same tests pass with 1GiB labels. See results/head-run.txt.

findings.note: Fix-validation for the premise: PASS means the worker tiered store still reaches the node capacity labels on the re-checked head.

Stale capacity labels limitation (disclosed by the author). Expected to report Still-broken until re-labelling of already-assigned nodes lands; the canary flips red at that point and must then be inverted. re-verify exiting non-zero because of F1 alone is expected.
